questions.question: When the Lamb opened the first seal, what did the rider on the white horse ride out to do?
When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, what was the name of the rider on the pale green horse?
In a vision of the Lamb opening the seals, the souls under the altar had been slain. What were they slain for?

answers.text: For the word of God and their testimony
For breaking the laws of their nation
For fighting in the armies of the king

questions.question: When the Lamb opened the sixth seal, kings and slaves begged the mountains to fall on them. Who were they hiding from?

answers.text: The One on the throne and the Lamb
The four riders on the horses
